name: Good Will Instrument Co., Ltd.
summary: Good Will Instrument Co., Ltd., established in 1975 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the development and distribution of electrical test and measurement devices. These precision instruments cater to a broad clientele, serving both educational institutions and industrial manufacturing environments across approximately 80 countries worldwide. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of sophisticated equipment, including various oscilloscopes – from handheld and digital storage models to specialized training kits. The company also supplies advanced RF solutions, such as spectrum analyzers, RF training systems, and EMI problem-solving packages, alongside a diverse selection of signal generators, including arbitrary function, RF signal, DDS function, and analog function types, among other signal sources. Furthermore, Good Will Instrument offers robust DC and AC power supplies, along with DC and AC/DC electronic loads. Its measurement tools extend to bench-top and portable digital multimeters, digital clamp meters, and LCR meters. A range of specialized safety and diagnostic testers are also available, covering safety, leakage current, and AC ground bond testing, complemented by multiplex scanner boxes. The extensive lineup of other measurement devices includes DC milli-Ohm meters, AC power meters, digital IC testers, precision current shunts, automatic distortion meters, AC millivolt meters, frequency counters, battery meters, and logic probes and pulsers. Additionally, the company provides an assortment of essential accessories for its oscilloscopes, function generators, spectrum analyzers, power and load units, and general test & measurement equipment, in addition to power electronic modules and training systems.
